title: Power Tools, Issue 2

description.main: The second issue of Power Tools, a handmade zine of art, short fiction, essays, and poetry critical of generative AI, edited by Bart Fish. Seven contributors, six pieces.
description.extended:
The second issue of Power Tools, a handmade zine of art, short fiction, essays, and poetry that argues against generative AI and the companies selling it.

Issue 2 came out in February 2026 with seven contributors and eight more pages than the first. Its six pieces take up why fascists hate art, the myth of human amplification, the need for space for silence, sex bots, the AGI redactions, and the fight for cognitive liberty. The cover is a hot-pink photocopy collage of the Statue of Liberty, a staring eye, and a hardware-store flyer. The words "Justice" and "Freedom for some" run along its edges, and a white card printed with a blurred "AI" sits across the front.

Bart Fish, the artist behind the Power Tools art series, edits the zine and produces it by hand. The first issue appeared in November 2025 with writing by Ethan Marcotte, Mandy Brown, Johan C. Brandstedt, and Jürgen Geuter beside Fish's own poems. Each issue comes as a print copy with stickers or as a free PDF.
